notes: New: per-user access control. Administration > Users lets you create panel accounts and grant each one any combination of six areas - Translation, Free Service Gateway, Giveaway, Telegram Channel, SEO, General Settings - independently toggleable per user, editable any time from that same page. Existing accounts were automatically kept as full ('Super admin') access, so nothing changes for you unless you create a new user or edit an existing one's access. Installing panel updates and managing users themselves stay Super-admin-only regardless of section access, since either one can grant full access on its own. Requires 'Update database' after installing this update.
